description: Anti-slop house style gate. After a Write or Edit, runs the voice linter at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../anti-slop-brain/scripts/lint_voice.py over the file that was just written, but only when that file is prose (.md, .markdown, .mdx, .txt, .rst) and lies inside the current project (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR). On a house style violation it exits 2, which feeds the linter output back for self-correction; the write itself has already happened. It is installed and removed with this plugin and it never writes to any global or project settings file. It is NOT skill-gated: while the plugin is enabled for a project, it fires on every prose Write and Edit inside that project. See SECURITY.md, and hooks/README.md for scope, exit codes, failure behaviour and environment.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,os,subprocess,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or ''; s=os.path.join(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT',''),'..','anti-slop-brain','scripts','lint_voice.py'); root=os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR') or d.get('cwd') or os.getcwd()); rp=os.path.realpath(p) if p else ''; inside=bool(rp) and (rp==root or rp.startswith(root.rstrip(os.sep)+os.sep)); prose=os.path.splitext(p)[1].lower() in ('.md','.markdown','.mdx','.txt','.rst'); r=(subprocess.run([sys.executable,s,p],capture_output=True,text=True) if (inside and prose and os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.isfile(s)) else None); bad=bool(r) and r.returncode!=0; sys.stderr.write((r.stdout+r.stderr) if bad else ''); sys.exit(2 if bad else 0)"
